value.subject: Preschool Swim - January start for 乐乐
value.body: Hello, I am hoping to enroll my child 乐乐 in Preschool Swim, starting in January. I see that your site currently offers sessions beginning on 2026-11-21 and 2026-11-28, and a waitlist for the session beginning on 2027-01-09. Would it be possible for 乐乐 to start in January instead of one of the November sessions? If a spot is available or may open up, I would be grateful to know how to secure it. Thank you very much for your help.
